name: WasteWise
tagline: Smart bins and optimised collection routes for cleaner cities
problem: Trucks follow fixed beats, whatever the bins hold
Half-full bins get emptied while market bins overflow
Wasted diesel, crew hours and CO2 every single day
Citizens unsure which bin an item goes in

stats.label: urban solid waste generated in India (CPCB, approx.)
wet / dry / hazardous segregation required by SWM Rules 2016
avg bin fill at pickup on a fixed beat (our simulation)

solution: Forecast every bin's fill and time-to-full
Collect only bins that need it, with a stated reason
Bilingual bin guide and green-points ward leaderboard

features.title: Fill forecaster
features.desc: Seasonal smoothing learns weekday and market-day spikes; hours to full

features.title: Explainable pickups
features.desc: Rule A: >=75% at pickup. Rule B: overflow guard with +1 sigma margin

features.title: Route optimiser
features.desc: Clarke-Wright savings, 2-opt and truck packing in under 1 ms

features.title: Live map playback
features.desc: Animated trucks, bins coloured by fill, fixed beat toggle

features.title: Day simulator
features.desc: Same waste, two policies: km, diesel, CO2 and overflows side by side

features.title: Which bin? EN/TA
features.desc: Naive Bayes on English, Tamil and Tanglish names; green points

architecture: Smart bin sensors (simulated) -> daily fill readings
Forecaster -> predicted fill at pickup and tomorrow
Planner rules A/B -> today's bins with reasons
Clarke-Wright + 2-opt + LPT -> truck trips in shift
Simulator -> fixed beat vs WasteWise on same waste
Python stdlib API -> vanilla JS + SVG dashboard
algorithms: Seasonal exponential smoothing - per-bin daily fill forecast
OLS + weekday dummies (Gaussian elimination) - backtest rival
Longest-trip-first packing - trips onto trucks in shift
Multinomial Naive Bayes + char 3-grams - EN/TA bin guide
innovation: Predicts overflow before it happens, not after
Fair baseline: same trucks, window and waste
Every pickup, route and answer explained
Tamil + Tanglish item names out of the box

results.label: truck km and diesel vs fixed beat (30-day sim)
bin-guide accuracy on unseen item names

demo_flow: Run demo: trucks animate, 30 km vs 61.5 km today
Toggle fixed beat: 36 half-full pickups, 4 bins left
Route card: fixed order 45 -> CW 30.5 -> 2-opt 30 km
Click market bin: Wednesday spike, rule B fires
Next day: fixed beat overflows, WasteWise none
Ask Tamil 'thengai odu', earn green points, see Impact
impact: ~3,650 L diesel and ~9.8 t CO2 a year per 40 bins (sim)
~Rs 3.3 lakh diesel a year per 40 bins at Rs 90/L
Fewer overflowing bins near markets and bus stands
~1,480 crew truck-hours a year freed for sweeping
business: SaaS per bin per month for municipalities
Sensor + software bundle via local integrators
Segregation analytics for compost and recyclers
Free campus tier as a showcase
